title: Create, deliver, revoke, and audit a public review link
accessibility: Public review works without dashboard navigation assumptions
Password, player, comment, and approval controls are keyboard operable
Permission and error states are announced and not color-only
Automated critical and serious accessibility violations equal zero
securityInvariants: Token rows are not publicly enumerable
Password, expiry, revocation, view limit, download, and watermark policy are server-enforced
A link binds to an immutable asset version
View-limit increments and first access are atomic and replay-safe
persistence: External comments and approvals persist with reviewer attribution
Revocation takes effect for existing and new sessions
Every open, download, comment, and decision has an auditable event
concurrency: Parallel opens cannot exceed the configured view limit
A new version does not alter an already issued immutable link
degradedDependencies: Email failure leaves the link copyable and records delivery failure
Analytics failure does not bypass access policy
Watermark service failure fails closed when watermark is required
rollback: Revoked links remain revoked after application rollback
Rollback preserves password hashes and immutable version binding
